scope: Post-study replacement on the already observed panel. All contrasts are descriptive, including retained primary-form contrasts. Fresh responses do not create an unseen test panel. Original experiment unchanged.
gate_amendment: Development gate recorded diagnostically; full panel collected irrespective of gate. Scientific confirmation always false.
cost_policy: Three calls and 512-token completion caps per strategy; not equal FLOPs. New physical calls and logical reused-candidate portfolio charges reported separately.
failure_policy: Every recorded serving error remains an outcome. No selective retry. Incomplete schedule may resume under identical code/configuration/model digests/server.
exact_solver_timing_origin: Original frozen study; rechecking certificates does not create new timing measurements.
